description: Remove the sound track from an MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV video without re-encoding the picture (H.264, HEVC, VP9 or AV1). Returns an MP4. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The video file (MP4, MOV, WebM or MKV), base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped. The picture must be H.264, HEVC, VP9 or AV1. The result comes back the same way in `data`, as an MP4.

name.description: The video's filename. The result is named after it, with -no-audio.mp4 on the end.

name: remove_audio_from_video
title: Remove Audio from Video
